'''Ninjas in Pyjamas''' (often abbreviated to '''NIP''' and previously '''NiP''') is a [[:Category:Sweden|Swedish]] esports organization which was founded in 2000. They first began to compete in ''Counter-Strike 1.6'' until their dissolution in 2007. In 2012, the team returned with a ''Counter-Strike: Global Offensive'' squad. NIP also had ''Dota 2'', ''League of Legends'' and ''Overwatch'' rosters before joining ''Rainbow Six: Siege''.

Originally a ''[[starcraft:Team Liquid|Brood War]]'' clan, the team switched to ''[[starcraft2:Team Liquid|StarCraft II]]'' during the SC2 Beta in 2010, and became one of the most successful foreign teams. On January 15, 2018, it was announced that the team had formed a Rainbow Six Siege division.{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/TeamLiquid/status/953009238388985857|title=We are pleased to announce our entry into Rainbow Six!|date=2018-01-15|publisher='''Team Liquid'''}} Team Liquid is also strongly associated with its website, [https://teamliquid.net TeamLiquid.net]. Launched on May 1, 2001, it has developed through the years into a focal point for StarCraft coverage, eventually became the most-browsed StarCraft-related website in the world, gathering thousands of members (including several professional players) and centralizing news about the global SC2 scene.
